review.summary: Phoenix is currently in a research-only phase with significant gaps in its architecture and controls. The absence of settled 24-month outcomes and verified observations from BCS, along with the fact-check stage being injectable but not canonical, raises concerns about its readiness for production.
top_technical_reasons: Not all storage backends are connected.
Fact-check stage is injectable but not yet canonical.
Orchestrator not yet wired into Streamlit runtime.
